e: Domyślnie `page` = **1**, `count` = **24** produkty na stronę. 50 to limit legacy Search API (`_from`/`_to`), nie Intelligent Search.

q: An Intelligent Search request uses the facets path `category-1/shoes/color/blue/color/red`. Which statements are correct?
o: Values of the same facet (`color`) are combined with OR
Different facets (`category-1` and `color`) are combined with AND
All facet values are combined with AND
The order of the facets in the path changes the result
Only the last `color` value is applied
e: Ten sam facet kilka razy = **OR** (suma: niebieskie lub czerwone). Różne facety = **AND** (część wspólna). Kolejność w ścieżce nie ma znaczenia. Wykluczenie: prefiks `not:`, np. `size/not:42`.

q: Which `sort` value lists Intelligent Search results from the cheapest to the most expensive?
o: `price:asc`
`OrderByPriceASC`
`price:desc`
`price,asc`
e: Intelligent Search: `sort=price:asc`. Bez `sort` wyniki są po **trafności** (relevance). `OrderByPriceASC` to parametr `O` w legacy Search API, `pole,asc` to List orders.

q: A legacy Search API request sends `_from=0&_to=99`. Why is it not allowed?
o: `_from` and `_to` must not differ by more than 50
`_from` and `_to` must be sent in the request body instead
Pagination must be sent in the `REST-Range` header instead
`_to` cannot be higher than 25 on a public request
e: Różnica między `_from` a `_to` maks. **50**, więc jedno zapytanie to maks. 50 wyników. Dodatkowo limit **2500** pozycji na jedno wyszukiwanie. Stronicowanie nagłówkami zostało wycofane.

q: Which cookie holds the commercial conditions of a session, can be shared among different users and controls the cache key of the pages?
o: `vtex_segment`
`vtex_session`
`VtexIdclientAutCookie`
`checkout.vtex.com`
e: `vtex_segment` = warunki handlowe, wspólne dla wielu użytkowników, i **klucz cache** stron. `vtex_session` = indywidualna sesja jednego użytkownika.

q: When is `regionId` generated in a VTEX session?
o: When a `postalCode` or `geoCoordinates` and a `country` are added to the session
When the shopper logs in
When an orderForm is created for the session
When `POST /api/sessions` sends `public.regionId` in the body
e: `regionId` powstaje, gdy do sesji trafi **`postalCode` lub `geoCoordinates` oraz `country`**. Leży w namespace `checkout`.

q: A regionalized store moves from the legacy Intelligent Search API to Intelligent Search API v1. How is the region passed to product search and facets?
o: Explicitly, as the `regionId` query parameter
Automatically, from the `vtex_segment` cookie
As a `region` facet in the path
In an `X-VTEX-Region` header
e: W legacy API `regionId` był polem segmentu. W **v1** podajesz go **jawnie**: `?regionId=...` na product search i facets.

q: What is the base path of Intelligent Search API v1?
o: `/api/intelligent-search/v1`
`/api/io/_v/api/intelligent-search`
`/api/catalog_system/pub/products/search`
`/api/intelligent-search/pub/v1`
e: v1: `/api/intelligent-search/v1`. Prefiks IO znika, podkreślniki zmieniają się w myślniki (`product_search` → `product-search`). `/api/io/_v/api/intelligent-search` to legacy, `catalog_system` to legacy Search API.

q: You stored the custom key `storeId` in the `public` namespace. How do you read only that key with `GET /api/sessions`?
o: `?items=public.storeId`
`?fields=public.storeId`
`?_fields=storeId`
`?namespace=public&key=storeId`
e: Parametr **`items`** w formacie `namespace.klucz`, kilka po przecinku: `items=public.storeId,store.channel`. `_fields` to Master Data.

q: A developer wants storefront JavaScript to call a private VTEX API with the store's `appKey` and `appToken`. What is the problem?
o: Client-side code exposes the key and makes the store vulnerable to attacks
VTEX rejects application keys sent from a browser with `403 Forbidden`
Browsers remove `X-VTEX-API-*` headers from cross-origin requests
Application keys only authenticate `/pub` routes, not `/pvt` routes
e: Dokumentacja kluczy mówi wprost: nie używaj app keys w kodzie po stronie klienta, bo to naraża sklep na ataki. Frontend uwierzytelnia się user tokenem.

q: An integration only reads orders. Following VTEX guidance on API key permissions, which roles should its key get?
o: Only the roles strictly necessary to read orders
The Owner (Admin Super) role, so future endpoints also work
User Administrator - RESTRICTED together with an OMS role
No role, because an active key can call any `/pvt` route
e: VTEX zaleca przypisywać kluczowi tylko niezbędne role, np. integracja czytająca zamówienia dostaje rolę tylko do odczytu zamówień. Klucz bez ról nie ma dostępu do zasobów.

q: When can you see the API token of a newly created VTEX API key?
o: Only once, when the key is created
Any time you open the key in Account settings > API keys
In the response of `GET /api/vlm/appkeys`
In the Audit module, in the key creation event
e: API token jest wyświetlany tylko raz, przy tworzeniu klucza. Trzeba go od razu bezpiecznie zapisać. Zgubiony token odnawiasz.

q: A partner asks for your `appToken` in a support ticket to debug an integration. What does VTEX recommend?
o: Do not share the token through tickets, email or chat
Share it in the ticket and rotate it within 24 hours
Send it as an encrypted attachment to the ticket
Share only the `appKey`, since the token alone is useless
e: VTEX każe chronić parę klucz + token jak dane logowania i nie udostępniać jej mailem, w ticketach ani na czacie.

q: Which transport security requirement applies to VTEX API routes?
o: HTTPS with TLS 1.2
HTTPS with TLS 1.0 or later
HTTP is accepted on `/pub` routes
Mutual TLS with a client certificate per API key
e: Wszystkie trasy VTEX wymagają HTTPS z TLS 1.2. Klient bez TLS 1.2 nie nawiąże połączenia.

q: According to VTEX, what can happen when an integration keeps exceeding API rate limits?
o: A temporary suspension of access to VTEX Core Commerce APIs
The API key is deleted and must be created again
Requests over the limit are queued and run the next day
The account is moved to a lower rate limit tier for 30 days
e: Przekraczanie limitów może przerwać działanie usługi i czasowo zawiesić dostęp do API VTEX Core Commerce. Przy `429` stosuj wykładniczy backoff.

q: Where in VTEX do you find which user or token performed an operation, and when?
o: Audit
License Manager › Access logs
VTEX ID › Session history
Store Settings › API keys › Activity
e: Audit zapisuje operacje, ich autorów i czas. Kolumna Author to e-mail, ID lub token tego, kto wykonał zdarzenie.

q: VTEX recommends keeping the number of users with which role as low as possible?
o: Owner (Admin Super)
User Administrator - RESTRICTED
Call center operator
OMS - Full access
e: Owner (Admin Super) daje nieograniczony dostęp do wszystkich zasobów platformy, dlatego liczba użytkowników z tą rolą powinna być jak najmniejsza.

q: How often does VTEX recommend renewing API tokens?
o: Every 90 or 180 days, because tokens do not expire automatically
Every 24 hours, like VTEX ID user tokens
Every 30 days, before the token expires automatically
Only after a leak, because renewal deactivates the key
e: Tokeny nie wygasają same, a im starsze, tym większe ryzyko. VTEX zaleca odnawianie co 90 lub 180 dni, zależnie od polityki firmy.

q: A Master Data v1 field holds confidential data. Which field options do you uncheck to block access without credentials?
o: Make readable without credentials
Allow editing without credentials
Allow filtering without credentials
Allow indexing without credentials
e: Instrukcja każe kliknąć ikonę koła zębatego przy polu i odznaczyć trzy opcje: odczyt, edycję i filtrowanie bez danych uwierzytelniających. Potem zapisz i opublikuj encję.

q: You restricted public access to Master Data v1 fields. What does a user now need to access that data?
o: A role with a Master Data generic resource and a Dynamic Storage generic resource
A role with any Master Data generic resource, such as `READONLY_USER_CRM`
Only a valid `VtexIdclientAutCookie`, regardless of roles
A role with the Save user resource
e: Po zmianie potrzebna jest rola z co najmniej jednym zasobem z Generic resources w Master Data (np. `READONLY_USER_CRM`) i co najmniej jednym z Dynamic Storage (np. `READONLY_USER_DS`).

q: How far back can you search records in the VTEX Audit module?
o: The last 3 months
The last 30 days
The last 12 months
Since the account was created
e: W Audit przeszukasz tylko rekordy z ostatnich 3 miesięcy. Do podglądu potrzebna jest rola z zasobem Insights Metrics.

q: After rotating a token, which steps does the VTEX rotation checklist include?
o: Remove the old token from vaults and environment variables
Monitor logs for failed authentication attempts
Delete the API key and create a new one with the same roles
Wait 24 hours, after which the old token stops working
e: Lista kontrolna rotacji: usuń stary token z sejfów i zmiennych środowiskowych oraz obserwuj logi pod kątem nieudanych prób uwierzytelnienia. Stary token wyłącza `finish-renewal`, nie upływ czasu.

q: In the VTEX gift card architecture, what is the Gift Card Hub?
o: The system that manages all gift card providers registered to a store from a single point
The native VTEX gift card provider, `VtexGiftCard`
The protocol that external gift card providers must implement
A Payment Provider Protocol connector dedicated to gift cards
The Admin module where gift cards are created in batches
e: Gift Card Hub to warstwa, która zarządza **wieloma** providerami gift cardów sklepu (natywnym i zewnętrznymi) z jednego miejsca. Protokół to Giftcard Provider Protocol, a natywny provider to `VtexGiftCard`.

q: Which request registers an external gift card provider in a VTEX account?
o: `PUT /api/giftcardproviders/{giftCardProviderId}`
`POST /api/giftcardproviders`
`POST /api/giftcards` with a `provider` field
`PUT /api/payments/pvt/affiliations/{affiliationId}`
`POST /api/giftcardproviders/{giftCardProviderId}/giftcards`
e: Providera rejestrujesz (lub aktualizujesz) przez **Gift Card Hub API**: `PUT /api/giftcardproviders/{giftCardProviderId}`. `POST .../giftcards` tworzy gift card u już zarejestrowanego providera.

q: Which headers does VTEX send with every call to an external gift card provider's protocol endpoints?
o: `X-PROVIDER-API-AppKey` and `X-PROVIDER-API-AppToken`
`X-VTEX-API-AppKey` and `X-VTEX-API-AppToken`
`VtexIdclientAutCookie`
`Authorization: Bearer` with an OAuth token
`X-VTEX-Provider-Key` and `X-VTEX-Provider-Token`
e: VTEX wysyła `appKey` i `appToken` podane przy rejestracji jako `X-PROVIDER-API-AppKey` i `X-PROVIDER-API-AppToken`. Nagłówki `X-VTEX-API-*` to poświadczenia konta, użyte w samym `PUT` do Hub.

q: A protocol call reaches a gift card provider without the provider credential headers. What should the provider return?
o: `401 Unauthorized` with an empty body
`403 Forbidden` with an empty body
`400 Bad Request` with an error message
`200 OK` with an empty array
`404 Not Found`
e: Brak nagłówków → **`401`** z pustym body. Błędne poświadczenia → **`403`** z pustym body.

q: A customer has no gift cards at an external provider. How should the provider answer `POST /giftcards/_search`?
o: With an empty array `[]`
With one gift card object with `"balance": 0`
With `404 Not Found`
With `204 No Content`
With `200 OK` and `null`
e: Bez gift cardów albo przy saldzie 0 zawsze zwracaj **pustą tablicę `[]`**. Obiekt z `"balance": 0` może zepsuć flow gift carda w VTEX.

q: Which rules apply to the `serviceUrl` of an external gift card provider?
o: It must include at least one path segment, not only the root domain
It must not end with a trailing slash
It must end with `/giftcards`, because VTEX appends only the gift card ID
It must use the account host `{accountName}.vtexcommercestable.com.br`
VTEX adds a `/` separator, so a trailing slash is ignored
e: `serviceUrl` ma mieć co najmniej jeden segment ścieżki i **bez** końcowego `/`. VTEX dokleja ścieżki protokołu (np. `/giftcards/_search`) wprost, bez separatora.

q: Within how many seconds must an external gift card provider respond to VTEX?
o: 15 seconds
5 seconds
30 seconds
60 seconds
2 minutes
e: Wymaganie dla providera: odpowiedź w ciągu **15 sekund**.

q: In the settlement and cancellation flows, what does VTEX do before it sends a `POST` to the gift card provider?
o: It calls the matching `GET` endpoint first
It calls `POST /giftcards/_search` to recheck the balance
It calls the provider's `GET /manifest`
It waits for a callback to its `callbackUrl`
Nothing, it sends the `POST` directly
e: W settlement i cancellation VTEX **zawsze najpierw woła `GET`**, a dopiero potem wysyła `POST`. `GET /manifest` należy do Payment Provider Protocol, nie gift cardów.

q: You create a transaction with `POST /giftcards/{giftCardId}/transactions` in the native Giftcard API. What must be true about `requestId`?
o: It must differ from the ones previously used for that gift card
It must equal the order ID
It must equal the gift card's `redemptionCode`
It is optional, VTEX generates it
It must repeat the `requestId` of the matching credit
e: Każda nowa transakcja potrzebuje **nowego** `requestId`, innego niż poprzednie dla tego gift carda.

q: How do you add 500 to the balance of a native gift card through the API?
o: `POST /giftcards/{giftCardId}/transactions` with `"operation": "Credit"` and `"value": 500`
`PATCH /giftcards/{giftCardId}` with `"balance": 500`
`PUT /giftcards/{giftCardId}` with `"balance": 500`
`POST /giftcards/{giftCardId}/transactions` with `"operation": "Debit"` and `"value": -500`
`POST /giftcards/{giftCardId}/transactions/{transactionId}/settlements` with `"value": 500`
e: Saldo zmieniasz **transakcją**: `Credit` dodaje, `Debit` odejmuje, a `value` jest dodatnie. Gift card z API startuje z saldem 0.

q: Which native gift card field lets the card be used in several purchases until its balance is used up?
o: `multipleRedemptions`
`multipleCredits`
`restrictedToOwner`
`relationName`
`isReusable`
e: `multipleRedemptions: true` = wiele zakupów, aż saldo się skończy. `multipleCredits` mówi, czy saldo można zmieniać, a `restrictedToOwner` zawęża użycie do `profileId`.

q: What are the rate limits of the Giftcard API endpoints?
o: 500 concurrent requests and 5000 requests per minute
100 concurrent requests and 1000 requests per minute
5000 concurrent requests and 500 requests per minute
50 requests per second per account
There is no rate limit
e: Giftcard API: limit **500 równoległych** requestów i **5000 na minutę**.

q: A debit transaction on a native gift card is canceled with `POST .../transactions/{transactionId}/cancellations`. What happens to the balance?
o: The canceled amount is credited back to the gift card balance
Nothing changes until the transaction is settled
The canceled amount is debited a second time
The gift card is deactivated
A new gift card is issued with the canceled amount
e: Anulowanie debetu **oddaje** anulowaną kwotę na saldo. Anulować można całość lub część.

q: What is true about the native `VtexGiftCard` provider?
o: It comes from a legacy system and is not a reference implementation of the Giftcard Provider Protocol
It is the reference implementation that external providers should follow
It is the only gift card provider a store can have active
It is a promotion that is applied automatically at checkout
It is called through the `serviceUrl` registered in Gift Card Hub
e: `VtexGiftCard` powstał z systemu legacy, więc **nie** jest wzorcową implementacją protokołu. Sklep może mieć naraz natywnego i zewnętrznych providerów. Gift card to metoda płatności, nie promocja.

q: Which media type must every gift card provider protocol endpoint accept?
o: `application/vnd.vtex.giftcards.v1+json`
`application/vnd.vtex.ds.v10+json`
`application/vnd.vtex.payments.v1+json`
`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
`text/plain`
e: Wszystkie endpointy protokołu muszą przyjmować `application/vnd.vtex.giftcards.v1+json`.

q: In the Admin, which connector do you pick when you create a payment condition for gift cards?
o: Vale
GiftCard HUB
VtexGiftCard
Promissory
Custom Payment
e: **Payment Conditions** › `+` › konektor **Vale**, potem w **Process with provider** wybierasz providera gift cardów. GiftCard HUB to provider w zakładce **Providers**.

q: Match each task to the VTEX API that exposes its endpoint.
o: Create or update the base price of an SKU
Simulate a cart for a postal code
Cancel an order
Set the stock of an SKU in a warehouse
Look up an SKU ID by its reference code
e: Cena: `PUT /pricing/prices/{itemId}` (Pricing). Symulacja: `POST /api/checkout/pub/orderForms/simulation` (Checkout). Anulowanie: `POST /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}/cancel` (Orders). Stan magazynu: `PUT /api/logistics/pvt/inventory/skus/{skuId}/warehouses/{warehouseId}` (Logistics). SKU po RefId: `/api/catalog_system/pvt/sku/stockkeepingunitidbyrefid/{refId}` (Catalog).

q: Match each credential to the HTTP header that carries it.
o: The `appKey` of an API key pair
The `appToken` of an API key pair
A user token for an Admin session
`ctx.authToken` sent from a VTEX IO app
e: Para kluczy idzie w dwóch nagłówkach: `X-VTEX-API-AppKey` i `X-VTEX-API-AppToken`. Token użytkownika (Admin) i `ctx.authToken` aplikacji IO wysyłasz w `VtexIdclientAutCookie`.

q: Put the calls that place an order from an existing cart in the right order.
o: `GET /api/checkout/pub/orderForm` to get the `orderFormId`
`POST /api/checkout/pub/orderForm/{orderFormId}/transaction`
`POST https://{accountName}.vtexpayments.com.br/api/pub/transactions/{transactionId}/payments`
`POST /api/checkout/pub/gatewayCallback/{orderGroup}`
e: Najpierw `orderFormId` koszyka, potem złożenie zamówienia przez `/transaction`, wysyłka płatności do bramki i na końcu przetworzenie przez `gatewayCallback`. Płatność i przetworzenie muszą się zmieścić w 5 minutach.

q: Put the steps of placing a new order without a cart in the right order.
o: `POST /api/checkout/pub/orderForms/simulation`
`PUT /api/checkout/pub/orders`
Send the payment information to `{accountName}.vtexpayments.com.br`
`POST /api/checkout/pub/gatewayCallback/{orderGroup}`
e: Symulacja daje opcje dostawy i płatności do orderForm. Potem `PUT /api/checkout/pub/orders` składa zamówienie, a w 5 minut wysyłasz płatność i przetwarzasz zamówienie.

q: Match each statement to the way of placing an order it describes.
o: Places a new order in one request with the full orderForm as the body
Needs a cart that already has items, customer data, an address and a payment method
Is the method the docs generally recommend
Answers `201 Created`, not `200 OK`
e: „Place new order” (`PUT /api/checkout/pub/orders`) wysyła cały orderForm jednym requestem i zwraca `201 Created`. „Place order from existing cart” (`/transaction`) wymaga kompletnego koszyka i jest ogólnie zalecany.

q: Your integration placed an order from a cart. It sends the payment information six minutes later. What happens?
o: The order was already canceled automatically: payment and processing must happen within 5 minutes
The payment is accepted and the order waits for `gatewayCallback` for up to 7 days
Checkout returns `CHK0016` because the value no longer matches the reference value
The order stays pending until the shopper pays from the order page
The payment is processed, and the order moves to `ready-for-handling` once the 30-minute cancellation window ends
The order moves to `payment-pending` and waits for the integration to call `start-handling`
e: Po złożeniu zamówienia masz 5 minut na wysłanie płatności i przetworzenie zamówienia. Inaczej zamówienie jest anulowane automatycznie. 7 dni to retry Create Payment w PPP, nie limit Checkout.

q: `POST /api/checkout/pub/gatewayCallback/{orderGroup}` returns `500`. Which cause do the docs name?
o: The payment has not been approved yet
The request lacks the `X-VTEX-API-AppToken` header
The order was already processed, so the call cannot be repeated
The cart has no `selectedSla` in `logisticsInfo`
The `orderGroup` in the path belongs to another account
The call was made to the `vtexpayments.com.br` host
e: `gatewayCallback` przetwarza zamówienie po zatwierdzeniu płatności. Jeśli płatność nie jest jeszcze zatwierdzona, zwraca `500`. Sukces to `204 No Content`.

q: A headless storefront calls `GET /api/checkout/pub/orderForm` without the `CheckoutOrderFormOwnership` cookie. What does it get?
o: The orderForm with masked personal data in `clientProfileData` and `shippingData`
`403 Forbidden`, because the cart owner is unknown
An empty cart with a new `orderFormId`
The full orderForm, because the `checkout.vtex.com` cookie alone identifies the owner
`401 Unauthorized`, because the request has no `VtexIdclientAutCookie`
The orderForm without `clientProfileData` and `shippingData`, which are removed
e: Bez cookie `CheckoutOrderFormOwnership` orderForm wraca z zamaskowanymi danymi osobowymi, np. w `clientProfileData` i `shippingData`. Cookie ustawiają requesty z danymi klienta i adresem.

q: Your integration places an order with only the email of an existing customer in `clientProfileData`. What must be true?
o: The customer's account must be logged into the store, or the process fails
The request must also send `document` and `documentType`
Checkout creates a new profile and ignores the existing account
The email must first be confirmed by the shopper through a link
The `userProfileId` of the customer must be sent in a request header together with the email
The email must belong to a profile created in the last 30 days
e: Dla istniejącego klienta e-mail wystarczy, żeby przypisać zamówienie do konta. Konto musi być jednak zalogowane w sklepie, inaczej proces się nie uda.

q: You place an order from a cart worth $24.99 with `POST .../orderForm/{orderFormId}/transaction`. What do you send as `value`?
e: `value` to łączna wartość zamówienia w centach: $24.99 to `2499`. Kwota musi się zgadzać z `referenceValue`, inaczej grozi błąd `CHK0016`.

q: Put the steps of an asynchronous payment in the Payment Provider Protocol in the right order.
o: VTEX calls `POST /payments` (Create Payment)
The provider answers with `status: undefined`
The provider calls the `callbackUrl` with the final status
VTEX sends `POST /payments/{paymentId}/settlements`
e: Przy płatności asynchronicznej provider odpowiada `undefined`, a wynik zgłasza później przez `callbackUrl`. Settlement startuje dopiero po autoryzacji płatności.

q: Match each situation to the PPP request VTEX sends to the provider.
o: The order is canceled; the payment was approved but not captured yet
The order is canceled after the payment was captured
The payment is authorized and the auto-settle delay has passed
e: Zatwierdzona, ale nieprzechwycona płatność idzie przez `cancellations`, przechwycona przez `refunds`. Po autoryzacji i opóźnieniu `delayToAutoSettle` VTEX wysyła `settlements`.

q: Create Payment returned `undefined`, and the provider has not called back yet. How long does VTEX keep retrying the call?
o: Up to 7 days
Up to 24 hours
Up to 30 days
Up to 5 minutes
e: Przy `undefined` VTEX ponawia Create Payment asynchronicznie do 7 dni, aż płatność zostanie przetworzona. 24 h to domyślne `delayToAutoSettle`, 30 dni to maksimum `delayToCancel`.

q: A payment connector built on VTEX IO gets the final result of an `undefined` payment. How does it use the `callbackUrl`?
o: It calls it without a payload, so the gateway calls Create Payment again
It posts the final status and `authorizationId` in the body
It calls it only after `delayToAutoSettle` has passed
It replaces the signature parameter with its own token
e: Z VTEX IO `callbackUrl` to endpoint retry: nie wymaga payloadu i sprawia, że bramka znów woła Create Payment. Bez VTEX IO to notyfikacja ze statusem. URL używasz dokładnie w otrzymanej postaci.

q: The provider's callback does not include `delayToAutoSettle`. Which value does VTEX use?
o: 24 hours
7 days
0 seconds, so settlement starts at once
30 days
e: Gdy opóźnień auto-settle brakuje w callbacku, VTEX ustawia je na 24 godziny. Wartości podaje się w sekundach.

q: VTEX sends the same settlement request twice for one payment. What should the provider do?
o: Return the same settlement response both times
Settle again and return a new `settleId`
Return `409 Conflict` for the second call
Ignore the second call and return an empty body
e: Provider musi być gotowy na wielokrotne otrzymanie tego samego settlementu i odpowiadać tak samo. To samo dotyczy Create Payment i Cancel.

q: A provider sets `delayToCancel` for a payment method that can stay pending for weeks. What is the highest value VTEX accepts?
o: 30 days (2592000 seconds)
7 days (604800 seconds)
24 hours (86400 seconds)
60 minutes (3600 seconds)
e: Maksimum `delayToCancel` to 30 dni, czyli 2592000 sekund. Dla Pix wartości muszą mieścić się między 15 a 60 minutami.

q: A store refunds one of three items from a payment that was already captured. Which request does VTEX send?
o: `POST /payments/{paymentId}/refunds` with the partial value
`POST /payments/{paymentId}/cancellations` with the item value
`POST /payments/{paymentId}/settlements` with a negative value
No request: VTEX does not support partial refunds
e: Po przechwyceniu pieniądze zwraca `refunds`, a VTEX obsługuje zwroty częściowe. `cancellations` dotyczy płatności zatwierdzonej, ale jeszcze nieprzechwyconej.

q: Put the calls of a purchase paid with a gift card through the Gift Card Hub in the right order.
o: Checkout lists the providers: `GET /api/giftcardproviders`
Checkout searches the customer's gift cards: `POST .../giftcards/_search`
Checkout gets the selected card: `GET .../giftcards/{giftCardId}`
Checkout creates a transaction: `POST .../giftcards/{giftCardId}/transactions`
The Gateway settles it: `POST .../transactions/{transactionId}/settlements`
e: Checkout najpierw pobiera providerów, potem wyszukuje karty, pobiera wybraną i tworzy transakcję (debet). Rozliczenie zleca na końcu Gateway przez Gift Card Hub.

q: Match each task to the part of the gift card integration that does it.
o: Forwards the search request from Checkout
Returns the customer's available gift cards
Creates the debit transaction
Receives the settlement request from the Gateway
e: Gift Card Hub przyjmuje requesty Checkout i Gateway i przekazuje je dalej. Provider odpowiada na endpointy protokołu: zwraca karty klienta i tworzy transakcję debetową.

q: A gift card provider receives `GET /giftcards/{giftCardId}`. What must its response contain?
o: The same `giftCardId` from the path and the current balance
A new `giftCardId` for the transaction
Only the balance, because the id is optional
The list of all the card's transactions
e: Provider zwraca ten sam `giftCardId`, który dostał w ścieżce, oraz bieżące saldo karty.

q: Where does VTEX take the `{transactionId}` for the gift card settlement and cancellation URLs?
o: The `id` returned when the transaction was created
The `giftCardId` from the request path
The `orderGroup` of the purchase
A value the provider creates at settlement
e: `id` zwrócone przy tworzeniu transakcji VTEX używa jako `{transactionId}` w URL settlement i cancellation.

q: A store wants the native gift card provider and an external one at the same time. Is that possible?
o: Yes, a store can activate several gift card providers at once
No, the native provider must be turned off first
Only if both providers use the same `serviceUrl`
Only through the Admin, not through the Gift Card Hub API
e: Sklep może aktywować kilku providerów kart jednocześnie, natywnego i zewnętrznych.

q: Before a settlement, VTEX calls GET and finds no amount left to settle. What does it do next?
o: It sends no `POST` settlement request
It sends a `POST` settlement with value `0`
It cancels the transaction
It retries the GET for up to 7 days
e: W settlement i cancellation VTEX zawsze woła GET przed POST. POST wysyła tylko wtedy, gdy zostaje kwota do rozliczenia albo anulowania.

q: Which credentials authenticate `PUT /api/giftcardproviders/{giftCardProviderId}`, the request that registers an external provider?
o: The VTEX account's app key and app token
The provider's `X-PROVIDER-API-AppKey` and `X-PROVIDER-API-AppToken`
An OAuth token from `oauthProvider`
None, because the endpoint is public
e: Rejestracja providera używa kluczy konta VTEX, nie providera. Nagłówki `X-PROVIDER-API-*` VTEX wysyła później do providera przy wywołaniach protokołu.

q: In the gift card integration, what is the external provider responsible for?
o: Only the protocol endpoints that VTEX calls through `serviceUrl`
Orchestrating the gift card flow in Checkout
Scheduling when the Gateway settles the order
Running the Gift Card Hub API
e: VTEX orkiestruje przepływy przez Gift Card Hub. Provider odpowiada tylko za endpointy protokołu wywoływane pod `serviceUrl`.

q: Put the calls of an external seller's order from a VTEX marketplace in the right order.
o: The marketplace calls the seller's `POST /pvt/orderForms/simulation`
The marketplace calls the seller's `POST /pvt/orders`
After payment approval, the marketplace calls `POST /pvt/orders/{sellerOrderId}/fulfill`
The seller sends the invoice with `POST /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}/invoice`
e: Najpierw symulacja fulfillment, potem złożenie zamówienia u sellera. Po zatwierdzeniu płatności marketplace autoryzuje wysyłkę (`/fulfill`), a seller na końcu wysyła fakturę.

q: In an external seller integration, match each call to its direction.
o: Price change notification
Fulfillment simulation
Authorize fulfillment
Invoice and tracking
e: Seller woła marketplace przy notyfikacjach ceny i stanu oraz przy fakturze z trackingiem. Marketplace woła sellera przy symulacji, zamówieniu, autoryzacji wysyłki i anulowaniu.

q: An external seller calls the catalog change notification for an SKU and gets `404`. What does it do next?
o: Send the SKU as an SKU suggestion, because the marketplace does not have it yet
Retry later, because the marketplace catalog is being indexed
Call the price notification instead, because `404` means the price is missing
Register the seller again, because the seller ID is unknown
e: `404` z change notification znaczy, że SKU nie ma jeszcze w marketplace. Seller najpierw wysyła je jako sugestię SKU. `200` znaczy, że SKU istnieje i seller aktualizuje dane.

q: How long does a VTEX marketplace wait for an external seller's fulfillment simulation response?
o: 2.5 seconds
5 seconds
20 seconds
60 seconds
e: Marketplace czeka na odpowiedź endpointu fulfillment najwyżej 2,5 sekundy. Wolniejszy seller wypada z symulacji.

q: The marketplace calls the seller's `POST /pvt/orders/{sellerOrderId}/fulfill`. What does the request body carry?
o: Only the `marketplaceOrderId`
The full order with its payment data
The invoice number and its value
The `sellerOrderId` and the chosen shipping SLA
e: Body autoryzacji wysyłki ma tylko `marketplaceOrderId`, który identyfikuje zamówienie w marketplace.

q: An external seller has the tracking number of an invoiced order. How does it send it to the VTEX marketplace?
o: Through the invoice endpoint again, with carrier and tracking data
Through `POST /pvt/orders/{sellerOrderId}/fulfill` with a tracking body
Through a catalog change notification for the SKU
Through `POST /pvt/orderForms/simulation` with the tracking URL
e: Tracking (przewoźnik, numer i URL śledzenia) seller wysyła tym samym endpointem co fakturę. Endpoint faktury to `POST /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}/invoice`.

q: A VTEX marketplace wants to cancel an order at an external seller. How does the cancellation work?
o: The seller's cancel endpoint is called twice: evaluate, then confirm or refuse
The seller's cancel endpoint is called once and the seller must accept
The seller cancels by calling the marketplace's `/fulfill` endpoint
The marketplace sends a return invoice to the seller to cancel it
e: Request anulowania przychodzi dwa razy: ocena, potem potwierdzenie albo odmowa. Odmowa oznacza wysłanie faktury i dalszą realizację.

q: An external seller wants to rename an SKU directly in the VTEX marketplace catalog. Can it?
o: No, the marketplace owns the catalog and approves offers
Yes, with the seller's own app key and app token
Yes, by sending a price change notification first
Yes, but only for SKUs the seller registered itself
e: Katalog należy do marketplace, a seller nie ma do niego bezpośredniego dostępu. Każde SKU sellera to oferta, którą marketplace musi zaakceptować.

q: Put the steps of an ERP order integration that uses the feed in the right order.
o: `POST /api/orders/feed/config`
`GET /api/orders/feed`
`GET /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}`
`POST /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}/start-handling`
`POST /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}/invoice`
e: Konfigurujesz feed, czytasz zdarzenia, pobierasz szczegóły zamówienia po `orderId` ze zdarzenia, raz wołasz start-handling, a gdy zamówienie jest gotowe do wysyłki, wysyłasz fakturę. Każde zdarzenie commitujesz.

q: Match each property to the order notification method it belongs to.
o: The integration pulls events and commits them
VTEX pushes events to a URL you set
The endpoint must answer HTTP 200 within 5000 ms
Events are removed after the retention period (at least 4 days), committed or not
e: Feed wymaga aktywnego pobierania i commitowania, a zdarzenia znikają po okresie retencji (co najmniej 4 dni). Hook sam wysyła zdarzenia na podany URL, a endpoint odpowiada `200` w 5000 ms.

q: Your ERP reads feed events and crashes before it commits them. What happens to those events?
o: They return to the feed after `visibilityTimeoutInSeconds`
They are lost and must be rebuilt from List orders
They stay hidden until the ERP reconnects with the same appKey
They move to the hook configured for the account
They are committed automatically after `messageRetentionPeriodInSeconds`
They are committed automatically after 5000 ms
e: Pobrane zdarzenia są ukryte przez `visibilityTimeoutInSeconds`. Gdy nikt ich nie zacommituje, wracają do feedu.

q: When should the ERP call `POST /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}/start-handling`?
o: Once, after it has the order details
On every feed event of the order
Before it reads the feed
After it sends the invoice
Once for every item of the order
When the order enters `window-to-cancel`
e: Start handling wołasz raz, gdy ERP ma już szczegóły zamówienia. Po start-handling pozycje zamówienia są zarezerwowane.

q: You configure a hook with `POST /api/orders/hook/config`, and your endpoint fails the ping. What happens?
o: The Hook API returns `400 Bad Request` and the configuration is not saved
The hook is saved and the ping is retried for three days
VTEX falls back to a feed for the same appKey
The hook is saved but paused until you resume it
The hook is saved, and VTEX sends the ping again with the first order event
The Hook API returns `503 Service Unavailable` and retries the ping
e: Przy konfiguracji VTEX wysyła ping `{"hookConfig": "ping"}`. Gdy endpoint go nie przyjmie, Hook API zwraca `400 Bad Request` i konfiguracja nie jest zapisana.

q: Put these order statuses in the order in which a regular order goes through them.
o: `payment-pending`
`payment-approved`
`window-to-cancel`
`ready-for-handling`
`handling`
`invoiced`
e: Po płatności zamówienie przechodzi przez okno anulowania, potem `ready-for-handling` (najważniejszy status dla ERP), `handling` i na końcu `invoiced`.

q: An order has a partial invoice. Can the retailer still cancel it?
o: No, orders with partial invoices cannot be canceled
Yes, until the order is fully invoiced
Yes, after sending a return invoice for the partial part
Only within the default 30-minute cancellation window
Yes, by calling Cancel order with the `reason` field
Only if the partial invoice has no tracking number
e: Zamówień z częściową fakturą nie da się anulować. Sprzedawca anuluje zamówienia tylko przed statusem Invoiced.

q: Your feed receives no new events for longer than its retention period. What happens?
o: The feed configuration is removed
The configuration stays but returns no events until reset
VTEX turns the feed into a hook
The retention period is doubled once
The events are kept until the next retrieve call
The feed is paused until the appKey commits an event
e: Gdy w okresie retencji nie pojawi się żadne nowe zdarzenie, konfiguracja feedu jest usuwana i trzeba ją utworzyć ponownie.

q: Put the steps to make an SKU sellable from a new warehouse in the right order.
o: Create the shipping policy
Create the loading dock
Create the warehouse
Update the SKU's inventory in that warehouse
e: Dokumentacja sugeruje kolejność: polityka wysyłki, dok, magazyn. Stan SKU ustawiasz na końcu, bo magazyn musi istnieć przed aktualizacją stanu.

q: Match each description to the logistics entity.
o: Defines the shipping conditions shown at checkout, with costs and deadlines
Connects the warehouse to the shipping policy
The physical place where products are stored
e: Polityka wysyłki określa warunki wysyłki w checkout. Dok łączy magazyn z polityką. Magazyn to fizyczne miejsce przechowywania produktów.

q: A shopper adds an SKU to the cart but has not placed the order. Is a reservation created?
o: No, only after the order is placed
Yes, for 30 minutes after adding it
Yes, until the cart itself expires
Only when the SKU is nearly out of stock
Yes, until the shopper's session ends
Yes, but only for logged-in shoppers
e: Dodanie produktu do koszyka nie tworzy rezerwacji ani pierwszeństwa. Rezerwacja pojawia się dopiero po złożeniu zamówienia.

q: An SKU was sold and the order was invoiced. Does VTEX subtract the sold units from the warehouse inventory?
o: No, the retailer or ERP updates the quantity
Yes, as soon as the payment is approved
Yes, automatically when the order is invoiced
Yes, when start-handling is called for the order
Yes, as soon as the order is placed
Yes, but only for orders shipped from the default warehouse
e: VTEX nie odejmuje sztuk z magazynu automatycznie. Robi to sprzedawca albo ERP w Admin albo endpointem aktualizacji stanu. Dokumentacja zaleca aktualizację po fakturze.

q: Which statements about the lead time of an SKU in a warehouse are correct?
o: It is added to the order's total shipping time
It cannot be negative
It defaults to five business days
It replaces the loading dock time
It is counted only for pickup orders
It is set per carrier inside the shipping policy
e: Lead time dolicza się do łącznego czasu wysyłki zamówienia i działa tylko na wartościach dodatnich. Domyślnie wynosi zero, a czas doku pozostaje osobnym składnikiem.

q: What is the maximum lead time you can set for an SKU in a warehouse?
o: 365 days
30 days
90 days
There is no limit
180 days
999 days
e: Lead time domyślnie wynosi zero, a limit to 365 dni.

q: When does an inventory reservation stop being subject to its expiration date?
o: When the payment is approved
When start-handling is called
When the order is invoiced
Never: it always expires after four days
When the order is placed
When the ERP sends a new inventory quantity
e: Po zatwierdzeniu płatności rezerwacja staje się potwierdzona i nie podlega już dacie wygaśnięcia. Anulowanie zamówienia anuluje też rezerwację.

q: An SKU has unlimited inventory enabled in its warehouse. Is it valid for sale?
o: Yes, while unlimited inventory stays on
Only if its quantity is also above zero
Only if its lead time is set to zero
Only in the default warehouse of the account
Only if it has an active reservation
No, unlimited inventory applies only to kits
e: Dopóki stan jest ustawiony jako nieograniczony, SKU jest zawsze dostępne do sprzedaży.

q: Match each HTTP method to its RFC 9110 properties.
o: `GET`
`PUT`
`DELETE`
`POST`
`HEAD`
e: Bezpieczne są GET, HEAD, OPTIONS i TRACE. Idempotentne są PUT, DELETE i wszystkie metody bezpieczne. POST nie jest ani bezpieczny, ani idempotentny.

q: A `PUT` that updates a price times out before any response arrives. Per RFC 9110, may the client repeat it automatically?
o: Yes, `PUT` is idempotent, so repeating it has the same intended effect
No, only `GET` may be repeated automatically
Only if the server sent a `Retry-After` header
No, `PUT` is not idempotent; send `PATCH` instead
Yes, but only when the request carried an `Idempotency-Key` request header
No, only safe methods such as `GET` and `HEAD` may be retried
e: PUT jest idempotentny, więc po błędzie połączenia request można automatycznie powtórzyć: zamierzony skutek jest ten sam.

q: Per RFC 9110, which header must a `401 Unauthorized` response include?
o: `WWW-Authenticate`
`Allow`
`Retry-After`
`Location`
`Proxy-Authenticate`
`Authorization`
e: Serwer, który zwraca `401`, musi wysłać nagłówek `WWW-Authenticate`. `Allow` jest obowiązkowy przy `405`.

q: A VTEX API call returns `403` although the app key and token are correct. What does it mean?
o: The request is understood but refused: check the roles
The app key or the app token is missing or wrong
The resource does not exist at this URL path
The HTTP method is not allowed on this resource
The request body has malformed syntax
The rate limit of the route was exceeded and the call must wait
e: `403` znaczy, że serwer zrozumiał request i odmawia, a przyczyna nie musi dotyczyć poświadczeń. W VTEX sprawdzasz role. Brak albo złe poświadczenia to `401`.

q: Your integration sends `GET` with `If-None-Match` and the stored ETag, which still matches. What does the server answer?
o: `304 Not Modified`
`412 Precondition Failed`
`200 OK` with the full body
`204 No Content`
`202 Accepted`
`409 Conflict`
e: Gdy znacznik z `If-None-Match` pasuje przy GET albo HEAD, serwer zwraca `304 Not Modified` i klient używa zapisanej kopii.

q: A `PUT` carries `If-Match` with an outdated ETag. What does RFC 9110 say the server does?
o: It does not perform the method and can answer `412 Precondition Failed`
It applies the change and answers `409 Conflict`
It answers `304 Not Modified`
It ignores `If-Match` for `PUT` requests
It answers `428 Precondition Required`
It performs the method anyway and returns the current `ETag` in a `200 OK` response
e: Gdy warunek `If-Match` nie jest spełniony, serwer nie wykonuje metody i może zwrócić `412 Precondition Failed`.

q: Which values can the `Retry-After` header carry?
o: A number of seconds to wait
An HTTP-date
The number of retries left
A rate-limit window in milliseconds
A Unix timestamp in milliseconds
A number of minutes to wait
e: Wartość `Retry-After` to data HTTP albo nieujemna liczba sekund opóźnienia.

q: Match each `Cache-Control` directive to what it tells a cache.
o: The cache must not store any part of the response
The cache may store it but must validate it before reuse
The response is stale after 60 seconds
e: `no-store` zabrania zapisu. `no-cache` pozwala zapisać, ale wymaga walidacji przed ponownym użyciem. `max-age` podaje, po ilu sekundach odpowiedź jest nieświeża.

q: Your backend integration syncs orders every hour. Which authentication do the VTEX docs recommend?
o: Application keys (appKey and appToken)
A user token from a VTEX ID login
The temporary token of a VTEX IO app
The browser cookie of an Admin user
An application key embedded in a storefront script
Basic authentication with an Admin user's email and password
e: Klucze aplikacji to zwykle najlepszy sposób uwierzytelnienia integracji i requestów z własnego backendu. Frontend używa tokenów użytkownika.

q: In which cookie does the user token of a store shopper travel?
o: `VtexIdclientAutCookie_{accountName}`
`VtexIdclientAutCookie` without a suffix
`X-VTEX-API-AppToken`
`checkout.vtex.com`
`VtexIdclientAutCookie_{storeId}`
`VtexIdclientAutCookie_{userId}`
e: Token klienta sklepu ma nazwę `VtexIdclientAutCookie_{accountName}` (albo z `accountId`). `VtexIdclientAutCookie` bez sufiksu to token admina.

q: For how long can a VTEX ID user token authenticate requests to VTEX APIs?
o: 24 hours after it is created
1 hour after it is created
7 days after it is created
Until the user logs out, with no time limit
30 minutes after the last request
12 hours after it is created
e: Przez 24 godziny od utworzenia token użytkownika może uwierzytelniać requesty do API VTEX.

q: A user token issued for account A is used to call an API on account B's host. What do the docs require?
o: The account in the API host must be the account the token was issued for
The user must have admin roles in both accounts
Only `/pub/` endpoints accept tokens from other accounts
VTEX ID exchanges the token for account B automatically
Account B must first add account A as a trusted account in License Manager
The token works on any account where the user's email exists
e: Konto w hoście API musi być tym samym kontem, dla którego wydano token. Każdy request używa poświadczeń ważnych dla konta, na którym działa.

q: An API you need cannot be authenticated with application keys. How do you still use your key pair?
o: Get a token from `/api/vtexid/apptoken/login`, send it as `VtexIdclientAutCookie`
Send the key pair in an `Authorization: Basic` header instead
Use the shopper cookie taken from the storefront session
Add the appKey and appToken as query parameters of the URL
Send the key pair in the request body of each call
Send `Authorization: Bearer {appToken}` and keep `X-VTEX-API-AppKey` in the same request
e: Gdy API nie przyjmuje kluczy aplikacji, generujesz token przez `POST /api/vtexid/apptoken/login` i wysyłasz go w `VtexIdclientAutCookie`.

q: Which permissions does a token from `POST /api/vtexid/apptoken/login` have?
o: The same permissions as the key pair it was generated from
The permissions of the admin who created the key
Full account access for 24 hours
Only shopper permissions
No permissions until roles are attached to the token
Read-only access to every resource of the account, whatever the roles
e: Token z tego endpointu nie jest powiązany z profilem użytkownika, tylko z kluczem API, i ma uprawnienia pary klucza.

q: Match each request source to the authentication the VTEX docs give for it.
o: Self-hosted backend request
Self-hosted frontend request
ERP job that reads orders every night
Frontend VTEX IO app
e: Własny backend i integracje używają kluczy aplikacji. Własny frontend używa tokenu użytkownika, a frontend VTEX IO bierze token użytkownika z kontekstu.

q: Your call to `GET /api/oms/pvt/orders` returns `401`. What do you check first?
o: That both credential headers are present and correct
That the key has a role with the orders resource
That the request rate is below the limit
That at least one order exists in the account
That the `Content-Type` header is set to `application/json`
That the request uses `POST` instead of `GET`
e: `401` znaczy brak albo złe poświadczenia, więc najpierw sprawdzasz `X-VTEX-API-AppKey` i `X-VTEX-API-AppToken`. Brak roli daje `403`, a limit `429`.

q: Put the steps of rotating an API token without downtime in the right order.
o: `PATCH /api/vtexid/apikey/{apiKey}/apitoken/renew`
Update every integration to the new token
Confirm that no integration still uses the old token
`PATCH /api/vtexid/apikey/{apiKey}/apitoken/finish-renewal`
Remove the old token from vaults and environment variables
e: `renew` daje nowy token, a stary dalej działa. Po podmianie we wszystkich systemach i sprawdzeniu, że stary nie jest używany, `finish-renewal` go wyłącza. Na końcu sprzątasz sejfy i zmienne.

q: Right after the `renew` call, what happens to the old API token?
o: It stays active until `finish-renewal`
It is revoked at once by VTEX ID
It expires on its own after 24 hours
It keeps working, but only for reads
e: `renew` generuje nowy token, nie wyłączając bieżącego, więc integracje działają bez przerwy do `finish-renewal`.

q: Which credentials authenticate the `renew` call for an API key?
o: Another valid key with Renew API Token
The same key that is being renewed
Any Admin user's browser token
No credentials, the call is public
e: Do `renew` używasz innego ważnego klucza (nie odnawianego) z zasobem License Manager API Key Management > Renew API Token.

q: How does the `finish-renewal` response confirm that the rotation is complete?
o: `creationDateNewToken` is `null`
It returns `204 No Content`
It contains the old token marked as revoked
It returns a new `apiKey`
e: `creationDateNewToken` równe `null` potwierdza, że stary token jest wyłączony, a rotacja zakończona.

q: After `finish-renewal` you find an integration that still used the old token. Can you undo the step?
o: No, the action cannot be undone
Yes, within 24 hours
Yes, by calling `renew` again with the old token
Yes, from the API keys page in the Admin
e: Zakończenia rotacji nie da się cofnąć, dlatego przed `finish-renewal` sprawdzasz, że żadna integracja nie używa starego tokenu.

q: Your team wants to reuse the store's browser JavaScript to build a back-office integration. What do the VTEX best practices say?
o: Don't: it often contains API keys
It is fine once the code is minified
It is fine for read-only endpoints only
It is fine if the keys stay in comments
e: Kod sklepu działający w przeglądarce często zawiera klucze API, więc zespół nie może używać go do integracji.

q: Which data should an integration cache to avoid rate-limit errors?
o: Data read often that changes rarely, with an expiry time
Every response, without an expiry time
Only error responses
Only the responses to `POST` requests
e: VTEX radzi cache'ować dane czytane często i rzadko zmieniane oraz ustalić, po jakim czasie są nieaktualne.

q: A legacy client calls a VTEX API over plain HTTP. What does it get?
o: `301 Moved Permanently` to HTTPS
`403 Forbidden` for insecure clients
`400 Bad Request` with a TLS hint
A normal response sent over HTTP
e: Połączenia HTTP dostają `301 Moved Permanently` z przekierowaniem na HTTPS. Klient bez TLS 1.2 nie nawiąże połączenia.

q: Your integration queues API calls to stay within rate limits. Which requests should go first?
o: Essential ones, such as checkout
The oldest ones in the queue
The largest ones
Catalog reads
e: VTEX radzi stawiać ważne requesty, np. checkout, przed mniej ważnymi, np. przez kolejkę albo poziomy priorytetu.

q: An integration gets a rate-limit error. How should it space its retries?
o: With delays that grow between attempts (exponential backoff)
At a fixed 100 ms interval until it succeeds
Immediately, with several requests in parallel
Once at once, then never again
e: VTEX radzi exponential backoff: opóźnienie między kolejnymi próbami stopniowo rośnie.

q: A VTEX IO app calls VTEX APIs directly in many places and hits rate limits. What do the docs advise?
o: Use dedicated Clients with cache and retry
Raise the app's rate limit in its manifest
Move the API calls into the browser code
Switch from the app token to an admin token
e: W VTEX IO zamiast bezpośrednich wywołań używasz Clients, które mają wbudowany cache oraz opcje retry i timeout.

q: Why do the VTEX docs suggest GraphQL for storefront data when rate limits are a concern?
o: It can combine several data needs into one request
GraphQL queries are not subject to rate limits
It caches every response for 24 hours
It needs no authentication
e: GraphQL może połączyć wiele potrzeb danych w jeden request, co zmniejsza ryzyko błędów limitu.

q: Your client calls `https://sandbox.vtexcommercestable.com.br/api/test` and gets `200 OK`. What does that tell you?
o: The client supports HTTPS with TLS 1.2
The client's API key and token are valid
The account is below its API rate limit
The sandbox store accepts test orders now
e: Trasa testowa sprawdza połączenie: `200 OK` znaczy, że klient obsługuje wymagane protokoły, czyli HTTPS z TLS 1.2.

q: An integration retries a failed `POST /api/checkout/pub/orders` automatically. What does RFC 9110 say about that?
o: `POST` is not idempotent, so a repeat has no same-effect guarantee
Nothing: RFC 9110 lets every method repeat automatically
The server must answer `412` to any repeated `POST`
The repeat is safe whenever it carries `If-None-Match`
e: RFC 9110 pozwala automatycznie powtarzać requesty idempotentne (PUT, DELETE i metody bezpieczne). POST nie jest na tej liście.

q: How often can the API Keys settings remind you to renew keys?
o: Every 3 or 6 months
Every month
Once a year
Only after a token leaks
e: W API Keys > Settings ustawisz przypomnienia o odnowieniu co 3 albo 6 miesięcy.

q: Why should a store run a periodic access review of its API keys?
o: Each integration keeps only the access it needs
API tokens expire on their own every 90 days
It raises the account's API rate limits
It renews all the account's tokens automatically
e: Regularny przegląd dostępu sprawia, że każda integracja ma dostęp tylko do potrzebnych zasobów. Tokeny nie wygasają same.

q: Put the Catalog API calls that take a new item to an active SKU in the right order.
o: `POST /api/catalog/pvt/category`
`POST /api/catalog/pvt/brand`
`POST /api/catalog/pvt/product`
`POST /api/catalog/pvt/stockkeepingunit`
`POST /api/catalog/pvt/stockkeepingunit/{skuId}/file`
e: Najpierw kategoria i marka, bo produkt musi do nich należeć. SKU tworzysz po produkcie, a obraz jest potrzebny do aktywacji SKU.

q: An SKU is active but does not show in the store. Which two things can still be missing?
o: A price in its trade policy
At least one unit in stock
A list price
A second specification group
A collection that includes it
A second image on the product page
e: Poza aktywacją SKU potrzebuje ceny w swojej polityce handlowej i co najmniej jednej sztuki na stanie, żeby było widoczne w sklepie.

q: Which ID does the main trade policy always have?
o: `default`
The account name
`main`
The ID of the first warehouse
e: Wszystkie produkty podłączasz do głównej polityki handlowej, a jej ID to zawsze 1.

q: Your import has just created a product. What should the integration keep?
o: The returned `id`, mapped to the product's RefId in its own database
Only the RefId, because VTEX ids can change
The product's URL slug instead of its id
Nothing, because VTEX resolves RefIds on every call
The SKU id of its first variation instead
The product RefId alone, because VTEX regenerates its id on every update
e: Przewodnik każe zapisać `id` zwrócone przez VTEX i powiązać je z RefId w bazie integracji.

q: Match each SKU setting to the activation mode it belongs to.
o: `ActivateIfPossible: true` when the SKU is created
`IsActive: false` and `ActivateIfPossible: false` when the SKU is created
The SKU becomes active once it gets an image
You update the SKU with `IsActive: true` after adding files
e: Automatycznie: `ActivateIfPossible: true`, SKU aktywuje się po dodaniu obrazu. Ręcznie: oba pola na false, potem `PUT` SKU z `IsActive: true`.

q: A specification group is created in a category. Which categories use it?
o: That category and all its children in the tree
Only that category
Only its subcategories, not the category itself
Every category in the whole catalog
That category and its parent categories
Only the categories in the main trade policy
e: Grupy specyfikacji kategorii przechodzą rekurencyjnie na wszystkie jej dzieci w drzewie kategorii.

q: An enumerated specification field (Combo, Radio or Checkbox) was created. What does it still need?
o: Values created with `.../specification/fieldValue`
A default value set on its category
A search index created in the catalog
A link to the main trade policy first
An `IsStockKeepingUnit` flag set to `true` on the field itself
A specification group in another category
e: Pola wyliczeniowe wymagają wartości specyfikacji, które dodajesz przez `POST /api/catalog_system/pvt/specification/fieldValue`.

q: Your ERP wants each SKU to keep its own numeric id in VTEX. Is that possible?
o: Yes, send an integer `Id` in the create request
No, VTEX always generates SKU ids itself
Only by storing it as the SKU's RefId
Only for SKUs that are kits
Only when the id is sent as a GUID
Only through the `skuId` query string of the request
e: Możesz podać własne `Id` (liczba całkowita) przy tworzeniu SKU. Bez niego VTEX generuje identyfikator.

q: You migrate `GET .../intelligent-search/product_search/{facets}` from the legacy API to v1. Which path do you call?
o: `GET /api/intelligent-search/v1/product-search/{facets}`
`GET /api/intelligent-search/v1/product_search/{facets}`
`GET /api/io/_v/api/intelligent-search/v1/product-search/{facets}`
`GET /api/intelligent-search/v1/search/{facets}`
e: W v1 podkreślenia stały się myślnikami, prefiks IO zniknął, a doszło `/v1`: `/api/intelligent-search/v1/product-search/{facets}`.

q: A v1 search request carries the shopper's `vtex_segment` cookie with sales channel 2. What does v1 do with the cookie?
o: Nothing: v1 does not read it, so you pass `sc=2` explicitly
It applies sales channel 2 from the cookie
It rejects the request with `400`
It merges the cookie with the `sc` parameter
e: Intelligent Search API v1 nie czyta cookie segmentu. Kontekst podajesz jawnie: kanał jako `sc`, kulturę jako `locale`.

q: With Intelligent Search v1, how do you fetch one product by its EAN?
o: `GET /api/intelligent-search/v1/products` by `ean`
`product-search` with an `ean` facet in the path
Only the legacy `product_search` endpoint
Only the Catalog API, not Intelligent Search
e: `GET /api/intelligent-search/v1/products` pobiera jeden produkt z pominięciem potoku wyszukiwania; pole to `id`, `slug`, `ean`, `sku` albo `reference`.

q: Where do v1 shipping facets such as `zip-code` go?
o: In query parameters with the same names
In the path, as key/value pairs
In the `vtex_segment` cookie
In the request body
e: Facety dostawy (`zip-code`, `coordinates`, `country`, `pickupPoint`…) mapujesz na parametry query o tych samych nazwach, nie na ścieżkę.

q: Match each property to the session cookie it describes.
o: Identifies one user's session
Holds commercial conditions such as price tables and sales channel
Can be shared among different users
Controls the cache key of pages
e: `vtex_session` to indywidualna sesja. `vtex_segment` trzyma warunki handlowe, może być wspólne dla wielu użytkowników i steruje kluczem cache stron.

q: In which session namespace are a customer's eligible price tables listed?
o: `profile`
`public`
`checkout`
`store`
e: Tabele cen dostępne dla klienta są w przestrzeni `profile`. `regionId` jest w `checkout`.

q: Does a call to the Session Manager API need an app key and token?
o: No, Session Manager requires no authentication
Yes, with the Sessions resource in a role
Only for `POST /api/sessions`
Only when the store is regionalized
e: Session Manager śledzi sesje przeglądania i nie wymaga uwierzytelnienia.

q: Which data does the `vtex_segment` cookie carry?
o: The sales channel
The price tables
The shopper's email
The items in the cart
e: W segmencie są m.in. kanał, tabele cen, `regionId`, kampanie i parametry UTM. Dane osobowe i koszyk tam nie trafiają.

q: Match each description to the price type.
o: Reference value for the computed price in all contexts
Retail price after the price rules of a context
Overrides the computed price for an SKU in a price table
Suggested retail price proposed by the supplier
e: Cena bazowa to punkt odniesienia, obliczona powstaje z reguł, stała nadpisuje obliczoną w tabeli, a katalogowa to sugerowana cena dostawcy.

q: You send an SKU's cost price and markup with `PUT /pricing/prices/{itemId}`. What happens to the base price?
o: VTEX calculates it as cost price × (1 + markup)
It stays empty until you send it
VTEX copies the list price into it
VTEX uses the highest fixed price
VTEX calculates it as cost price + markup
VTEX sets it to the cost price and ignores the markup
e: Gdy podasz koszt albo marżę, druga wartość jest wyliczana według wzoru `basePrice = costPrice * (1 + markup)`.

q: An SKU has no price of its own in the price table `vip`. Which price does that table use?
o: The SKU's base price, which it inherits
None, so the SKU cannot be sold there
The SKU's list price
The fixed price of the main table
The lowest price among the other price tables
The SKU's cost price
e: Jeśli SKU nie ma ceny w innej tabeli cen, dziedziczy cenę bazową.

q: One price table must sell an SKU at 80 whatever its rules compute. What do you create?
o: A fixed price for that SKU in that price table
A new base price of 80 for the SKU
A list price of 80 for the SKU
A coupon worth the price difference
A cost price of 80 for the SKU in that price table
A markup of 80 in that price table
e: Cena stała nadpisuje cenę obliczoną SKU w danej tabeli cen. Ustawiasz ją dla każdej pary tabela–SKU z inną ceną niż bazowa. Endpoint: `POST /pricing/prices/{itemId}/fixed/{priceTableId}`.

q: Which request returns the computed price of an SKU for one price table?
o: `GET /pricing/prices/{itemId}/computed/{priceTableId}`
`GET /pricing/prices/{itemId}`
`GET /pricing/tables/{priceTableId}`
`GET /pricing/pipeline/catalog/{priceTableId}`
`GET /pricing/prices/{itemId}/fixed/{priceTableId}`
`POST /pricing/prices/{itemId}/computed/{priceTableId}`
e: Cenę obliczoną dla jednej tabeli zwraca `GET /pricing/prices/{itemId}/computed/{priceTableId}`. `GET /pricing/prices/{itemId}` to ceny bazowe i stałe SKU.

q: How do you delete a price table?
o: Remove all its prices, then ask VTEX Support
Call `DELETE /pricing/tables/{priceTableId}`
Set it as inactive in the Admin
Delete the trade policy that uses it
Call `DELETE /pricing/pipeline/catalog/{priceTableId}`
Remove it from the trade policy settings in the Admin
e: Tabelę cen usuniesz tylko po usunięciu wszystkich jej cen i prośbie do supportu VTEX.

q: Which pricing type weighs more than any other?
o: Fixed price
Computed price
Base price
List price
Markup price
Cost price
e: Cena stała waży więcej niż każdy inny typ ceny: nadpisuje cenę obliczoną SKU w tabeli.

q: You set a fixed price for a custom price table that is not tied to a trade policy. What goes in `tradePolicyId`?
o: The price table's name
`1`, the main trade policy
Nothing, the field stays empty
The account name
The ID of the warehouse
`0`, meaning all trade policies
e: Dla własnej tabeli cen, niezwiązanej z polityką handlową, w `tradePolicyId` wpisujesz nazwę tabeli.

q: Put the steps to store validated documents and search them by a custom field in the right order.
o: `PUT /api/dataentities/{dataEntityName}/schemas/{schemaName}`
Save the document with `?_schema={schemaName}`
Search the custom field with `_where` and `_schema={schemaName}`
e: Najpierw schemat, potem zapis z `_schema`, żeby walidacja szła w trakcie requestu. Wyszukiwanie po polach własnych też wymaga `_schema`.

q: Match each property to the Master Data retrieval method.
o: Up to 100 documents per request
Up to 1000 documents per request
Pages with the `REST-Range` header
Continues with a token that expires in 20 minutes
e: Search zwraca do 100 dokumentów i stronicuje nagłówkiem `REST-Range`. Scroll zwraca do 1000 i kontynuuje tokenem z `X-VTEX-MD-TOKEN`, ważnym 20 minut.

q: You save a document with `?_schema={schemaName}` and it does not match the schema. What happens?
o: The API answers `400 Bad Request`
It is saved and flagged as invalid
It is saved and revalidated later in the background
It is saved without the invalid fields
e: Z `_schema` walidacja idzie w trakcie requestu, a niepoprawny dokument dostaje `400`. Bez tego parametru worker waliduje po requeście.

q: You change the schema of an entity that already has many documents. What happens to search meanwhile?
o: Search is inconsistent until revalidation ends
Search is blocked until revalidation ends
Nothing changes for search at all
Documents that fail the new schema are deleted
e: Zmiana schematu uruchamia rewalidację w tle, a do jej końca wyszukiwanie jest niespójne. Dokumenty niezgodne ze schematem zostają w bazie.

q: A Master Data v2 trigger action fails. What does Master Data do by default?
o: Makes three attempts in an interval of 10 minutes
Retries for up to seven days
Drops the action without retrying
Retries once after one hour
e: Domyślnie Master Data robi trzy próby w interwale 10 minut.

q: How do you know that a Master Data scroll has reached the end?
o: The response body is empty
`REST-Content-Total` drops to zero
The token header disappears
The API answers `204 No Content`
e: Scroll powtarzasz z tokenem, aż body odpowiedzi będzie puste. `REST-Content-Total` podaje łączną liczbę pasujących dokumentów.

q: Where do you set the page size of a Master Data scroll?
o: In `_size` of the first request only
In `_size` of every request
In the `REST-Range` header
Nowhere: it is fixed at 100
e: Rozmiar strony ustawiasz tylko w pierwszym requeście scrolla, maksymalnie 1000.

q: You add a trigger to a Master Data v2 entity that already has a schema. How?
o: Add it to `v-triggers` and save the schema again
Send it to a separate triggers endpoint
Configure it in the Master Data v1 Admin
Add a `_trigger` parameter to each save
e: Trigger to element tablicy `v-triggers` w JSON Schema. Pobierasz schemat, dopisujesz trigger i wysyłasz schemat do Save schema by name.
